title: Toast
description: Temporary notifications with a title, a description and a semantic color, shown with toast() from anywhere (no React context needed) and rendered by a ToastProvider inside your app tree, so they inherit your app's context (theme, locale). Loading toasts, promise tracking, in-place updates, actions and a maximum count are built in. Server rendering is safe.

usage.title: When to use which: useToast() or toast()
usage.hook: Inside components, call useToast(): the toasts it shows follow the nearest ConfigProvider scope. Under a nested provider they are rendered into its portal host, with its theme, palette and tokens, and their built-in labels use its language. The owning ToastProvider still renders them, with its position, max and labels.
usage.function: Outside React (event buses, API clients, stores and other non-component modules), import toast() directly: no hook is available there, and its toasts use the scope of the ToastProvider, usually the root theme and language.
usage.modal: While a modal dialog is open (Modal, Drawer, ConfirmDialog, Command, a modal Popover or Menu), its hide-others treatment covers the toast viewport like the rest of the page: the viewport gets aria-hidden="true" and assistive technologies only see the dialog until it closes. <minerva-toast-region> behaves the same way (opt out on a region with data-minerva-keep-visible).

props.name: position
props.description: Where the toasts are stacked

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum number of toasts shown at once; when exceeded the oldest close first

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pauses the auto-close timer while a toast is hovered or focused

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the toast region (used as is; the default one includes the hotkey)

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close buttons

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Keys pressed together to move focus to the toast region (the first one holding toasts): key codes (`"F8"`, `"KeyT"`), keys or modifiers (`"altKey"`, `"ctrlKey"`, `"metaKey"`, `"shiftKey"`). Shown in the default region label, e.g. "Notifications (F8)". An empty array disables it

props.name: id
props.description: Identifier of the toast; generated when omitted. Showing a toast with the id of a visible one replaces it (and restarts its timer) instead of stacking a duplicate

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the toast; sets its accent, icon and ARIA role ("danger" is announced as an alert, the others as a status)

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner instead of the icon and keeps the toast open (duration defaults to 0) until it is updated or dismissed; announced as a status

props.name: title
props.description: Main text

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text under the title

props.name: duration
props.description: Time in milliseconds before the toast closes automatically; 0 keeps it open. Loading toasts default to 0

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the color icon (or the loading spinner); null hides it

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows the close button

props.name: action
props.description: Action button rendered in the toast (e.g. "Undo")

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called once with the toast id when it closes, whatever the reason (timer, close button, action, dismiss, overflow of ToastProvider max)

ToastAction.description: Button rendered inside a toast; activating it also closes the toast

props.description: Visible text of the button

ToastApi.description: The `toast` function, and the API returned by `useToast()` (bound to the caller's ConfigProvider scope)

props.name: info
props.description: Shows an info toast with the given title

props.name: success
props.description: Shows a success toast with the given title

props.name: warning
props.description: Shows a warning toast with the given title

props.name: danger
props.description: Shows a danger toast with the given title

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading toast (spinner, no auto-close) with the given title

props.name: promise
props.type: <T>(promise: Promise<T>, messages: ToastPromiseMessages<T>, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "color" | "loading" | "title">) => Promise<T>
props.description: Shows a loading toast while the promise is pending, then turns the same toast into a success or danger toast. Returns the given promise

props.name: update
props.description: Changes an open toast in place (merging the options) and restarts its timer; `loading: false` turns a loading toast into a regular one (with the default duration unless one is given). Unknown ids are ignored

props.name: dismiss
props.description: Closes the toast with the given id, or every toast when omitted

ToastPromiseMessages.description: Messages of `toast.promise`: a node, or a function of the settled value

props.name: loading
props.description: Title while the promise is pending

props.name: success
props.description: Title once the promise resolves

props.name: error
props.description: Title once the promise rejects

vars.name: --toast-width
vars.description: Width of the toast stack (capped by the viewport)

vars.name: --toast-offset
vars.description: Distance between the stack and the viewport edges

vars.name: --toast-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of a toast (defaults to --radius-md)

vars.name: --toast-background
vars.description: Base background of a toast (under the color tint)

vars.name: --toast-z-index
vars.description: Stacking order of the stack (defaults to --z-toast)

vars.name: --toast-icon-background
vars.description: Background of the round chip behind the status icon (defaults to the color's accent at 14%)

examples.title: Action, icon and onClose
examples.description: action adds a button (e.g. Undo) that also closes the toast; icon replaces the color icon; closable: false hides the close button; onClose runs once when the toast closes.

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Success shows Saved, Danger shows Request failed, Warning shows Unsaved changes and Info shows New version. Keep at most three notifications.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: color picks the semantic color: info (default), success, warning or danger. It sets the accent, the icon and the role: danger is announced as an alert, the others as a status.

examples.title: Same id replaces
examples.description: Showing a toast with the id of a visible one replaces it and restarts its timer, instead of stacking duplicates (handy for polling errors).

examples.title: Keyboard
examples.description: F8 (the hotkey prop, also announced in the region label "Notifications (F8)") moves focus to the toasts. Escape dismisses the focused toast; after closing one, focus moves to the next toast's close button, then back to where it was before entering the toasts.

examples.title: Loading, update and promise
examples.description: toast.loading (or the loading: true option, with any color) shows a spinner instead of the icon and stays open; toast.update(id, { loading: false, ... }) turns it into a result in place. toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error }) does both for a promise.

examples.title: Options
examples.description: toast({ color, title, description, duration }) for full control; duration 0 keeps the toast until it is closed. toast.dismiss(id) closes one toast, toast.dismiss() all of them. Hovering or focusing a toast pauses its timer.

examples.title: Scoped: useToast() vs toast()
examples.description: Both buttons sit in a nested ConfigProvider (dark theme, tech palette, Chinese). useToast() renders its toast inside that scope (dark tokens, Chinese close label, its own viewport at the same position); toast() renders at the root, with the page theme and language.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A <minerva-toast-region> renders the toasts; region.toast is the toast() API bound to it (info, success, warning, danger). position places the stack. As with React's ToastProvider, an open modal dialog hides the region from assistive technologies (aria-hidden) until it closes.

options.title: Options and action
options.description: A toast with a title, a description, a longer duration and an Undo action. max keeps the newest toasts only; minerva-close tells why each toast closed.

loading.title: Loading and promises
loading.description: toast.promise() follows a promise in one toast; loading() then update() do the same by hand. Loading toasts stay open until updated; dismiss() closes every toast.

props.noPauseOnHover: Keeps the countdown running while a toast is hovered or focused.
props.toast: The toast API bound to this region: region.toast.success("Saved") renders in this element (read-only).

events.minerva-close: A toast of this region started closing (detail: { id, reason }; reason: timeout, close-button, action, escape, dismiss or overflow).
events.minerva-after-close: A toast of this region was removed after its exit animation (detail: { id }).

methods.focus: Moves focus to the region (as the hotkey does).

native.limitations: On Native, top-left/top-center/top-right map to a full-width top stack; bottom-left/bottom-center/bottom-right map to a bottom stack. Message actions and the maximum count match the web example; horizontal corner placement does not.
